replies.author: cxfoulke
replies.body:
Making games that rely on multiplayer is scary in general.  As a small indie team... you can sell less copies still make a living and be happy.  For multiplayer you need to start out with explosive numbers or people wont be able to find matches. You can't rely on launch into a gradual decay. For multiplayer moba you need at least 1000+ concurrents at most times in the day. That is an insanely high bar for indie titles.

Id tell basically anyone who is making a game in 2026 avoid multiplayer only like the plague. Normal indie games die on launch 99% of the time. Multiplayer indie games die on launch 99.99% of the time. 

Also Moba's inheriently have a learning curve and skill gaps. So you really want a larger playerbase. So you can protect the new players from vets. 

TLDR; I can think of maybe < 10 multiplayer indie games that sustain themselves. Most of those have some form of you dont need to play multiplayer unlike a moba. 

You basically have to be insane to try.

replies.author: kilographix
replies.body: I'm building a moba/rts game at the moment. My hope is that single player is fun enough on its own to tackle the learning curve. I also might extend the timescale out drastically instead and making it like 30 days instead of an hour if i have to. Im not making it for money though, mostly for myself and the experience.

replies.author: ADIRTYHOBO59
replies.body: Well maybe I'm a little insane. Bottom line though, I'm just at excited about the unique gameplay concepts that I have in mind that would make this fundamentally different from any other MOBA I've seen. So I figure if people get excited enough about those unique ideas (once they are fully realized) they may be inclined to support the Patreon at which point I could direct those funds towards paying real humans to create the visual assets, and also pay to promote the game via ads to see if that would be sufficient for growing a player base. It's a long shot, but I personally really want a game like this to exist, and none does right now.

replies.author: ADIRTYHOBO59
replies.body: I would consider it in Alpha, so I agree actually. I believe there is so much potential in the MOBA space. I'm very excited about some key differentiator ideas I have for the coming updates
